fields.label: server_name
fields.help: Name of the orchestrator Ray actor; clients find it by this name.
fields.help_it: Nome dell'attore Ray orchestratore; i client lo trovano con questo nome.

fields.label: namespace
fields.help: Ray namespace shared by the server and its clients.
fields.help_it: Namespace Ray condiviso dal server e dai suoi client.

fields.label: min_to_start
fields.help: Clients that must be registered before the first round. With several clients the server also waits for all of them at the end of every hour.
fields.help_it: Client che devono essere registrati prima del primo turno. Con più client il server li aspetta tutti anche alla fine di ogni ora.

fields.label: timeout_seconds
fields.help: Seconds after which a client that does not answer is considered lost.
fields.help_it: Secondi dopo i quali un client che non risponde è considerato perso.

fields.label: database.type
fields.help: Database engine.
fields.help_it: Motore del database.

fields.label: database.sqlite.filename
fields.help: SQLite file inside the experiment folder.
fields.help_it: File SQLite nella cartella dell'esperimento.

fields.label: simulation.num_rounds
fields.help: Hours to simulate (48 = two days, 168 = one week).
fields.help_it: Ore da simulare (48 = due giorni, 168 = una settimana).

fields.label: simulation.posts_per_round
fields.help: Reference number of posts per round of the example experiment.
fields.help_it: Numero di riferimento di post per turno dell'esperimento d'esempio.

fields.label: simulation.enable_sentiment
fields.help: Store a sentiment score for photos and comments.
fields.help_it: Memorizza un punteggio di sentiment per foto e commenti.

fields.label: simulation.enable_emotion_annotation
fields.help: Store the dominant visual emotion of new photos (photo_emotions).
fields.help_it: Memorizza l'emozione visiva dominante delle nuove foto (photo_emotions).

fields.label: simulation.enable_toxicity
fields.help: Score captions and comments with the Perspective API (needs perspective_api_key).
fields.help_it: Valuta didascalie e commenti con la Perspective API (serve perspective_api_key).

fields.label: simulation.perspective_api_key
fields.help: Key of the Perspective API; null disables it.
fields.help_it: Chiave della Perspective API; null la disabilita.

fields.label: logging.enable_console_log
fields.help: Also print the logs on the console.
fields.help_it: Stampa i log anche sulla console.

fields.label: logging.enable_server_log
fields.help: Write <server>_server.log.
fields.help_it: Scrive <server>_server.log.

fields.label: logging.enable_actor_log
fields.help: Write the structured actor log.
fields.help_it: Scrive il log strutturato degli attori.

fields.label: logging.enable_request_log
fields.help: Write the request trace _server.log.
fields.help_it: Scrive la traccia delle richieste _server.log.

fields.label: federation.enabled
fields.help: Join a multi-platform simulation (a coordinator keeps a shared clock). Off by default; nothing changes without it.
fields.help_it: Partecipa a una simulazione multi-piattaforma (un coordinatore tiene un orologio condiviso). Spenta per impostazione predefinita; senza di essa nulla cambia.

fields.label: federation.crosspost_mode
fields.help: How cross-posts are chosen when the federation is on (for example agent_action: the agent decides).
fields.help_it: Come si scelgono i cross-post quando la federazione è attiva (per esempio agent_action: decide l'agente).

fields.label: human.gateway.host
fields.help: Address where run_gateway.py listens (loopback).
fields.help_it: Indirizzo su cui ascolta run_gateway.py (loopback).

fields.label: human.gateway.port
fields.help: Port of the gateway; 0 picks a free one and writes it to human_gateway.json.
fields.help_it: Porta del gateway; 0 ne sceglie una libera e la scrive in human_gateway.json.

fields.label: client_id
fields.help: Identifier of this client (distinct for each client of a multi-client run).
fields.help_it: Identificatore di questo client (distinto per ogni client di una run multi-client).

fields.label: server_name
fields.help: Name of the server actor to connect to.
fields.help_it: Nome dell'attore server a cui connettersi.

fields.label: namespace
fields.help: Ray namespace of the server.
fields.help_it: Namespace Ray del server.

fields.label: address
fields.help: Address of the Ray cluster; auto finds the local one.
fields.help_it: Indirizzo del cluster Ray; auto trova quello locale.

fields.label: agents_file
fields.help: Population file of this client.
fields.help_it: File della popolazione di questo client.

fields.label: simulation.num_rounds
fields.help: Hours this client plays.
fields.help_it: Ore che questo client gioca.

fields.label: simulation.start_day
fields.help: Day on which the clock starts.
fields.help_it: Giorno da cui parte l'orologio.

fields.label: simulation.num_slots_per_day
fields.help: Slots (hours) in a day.
fields.help_it: Slot (ore) in un giorno.

fields.label: simulation.use_local_diffusion
fields.help: Generate real images locally with Hugging Face diffusers. When on, a post whose image fails is not published.
fields.help_it: Genera immagini reali in locale con Hugging Face diffusers. Se attiva, un post la cui immagine fallisce non è pubblicato.

fields.label: simulation.local_diffusion_model
fields.help: Diffusion model to load.
fields.help_it: Modello di diffusione da caricare.

fields.label: simulation.enable_sentiment
fields.help: Store sentiment for photos and comments.
fields.help_it: Memorizza il sentiment di foto e commenti.

fields.label: simulation.enable_emotion_annotation
fields.help: Store the visual emotion of new photos.
fields.help_it: Memorizza l'emozione visiva delle nuove foto.

fields.label: simulation.enable_toxicity
fields.help: Toxicity scores from the Perspective API.
fields.help_it: Punteggi di tossicità dalla Perspective API.

fields.label: simulation.perspective_api_key
fields.help: Perspective API key.
fields.help_it: Chiave della Perspective API.

fields.label: simulation.enable_memory_annotations
fields.help: Write memory events and load memory context into comments and direct messages.
fields.help_it: Scrive eventi di memoria e carica il contesto di memoria in commenti e messaggi diretti.

fields.label: simulation.discussion_topics
fields.help: Topics that exist in the experiment: agents post about them and build interest profiles on them.
fields.help_it: Argomenti che esistono nell'esperimento: gli agenti vi scrivono e ne costruiscono profili di interesse.

client.title: Who acts and what they do

fields.label: simulation.actions_likelihood
fields.help: Weight of each action in the random draw of a session (post_photo, react, comment, follow, share, report, save, reply_comment, unfollow, send_dm, post_story, watch_story). The archetype multiplies some of them.
fields.help_it: Peso di ogni azione nell'estrazione casuale di una sessione (post_photo, react, comment, follow, share, report, save, reply_comment, unfollow, send_dm, post_story, watch_story). L'archetipo ne moltiplica alcuni.

fields.label: simulation.activity_profiles
fields.help: Named profiles: the hours in which an agent with that activity_profile acts (with probability 1).
fields.help_it: Profili con nome: le ore in cui agisce un agente con quell'activity_profile (con probabilità 1).

fields.label: simulation.hourly_activity
fields.help: For agents without a profile: probability of acting in each hour (0-23), multiplied by daily_activity_level / 5. The default list peaks in the evening (excerpt shown).
fields.help_it: Per gli agenti senza profilo: probabilità di agire in ogni ora (0-23), moltiplicata per daily_activity_level / 5. L'elenco predefinito ha il picco serale (estratto mostrato).

fields.label: simulation.agent_archetypes
fields.help: Optional definitions of archetypes; built-in ones are broadcaster, explorer and validator.
fields.help_it: Definizioni facoltative di archetipi; quelli predefiniti sono broadcaster, explorer e validator.

client.title: Follow graph, churn and new users
client.title_it: Grafo dei follow, abbandono e nuovi utenti

fields.label: simulation.agents.probability_of_secondary_follow
fields.help: After its actions, the probability of following each account the agent interacted with.
fields.help_it: Dopo le sue azioni, la probabilità di seguire ogni account con cui l'agente ha interagito.

fields.label: simulation.agents.probability_of_follow_back
fields.help: Probability that a public account follows back a new follower.
fields.help_it: Probabilità che un account pubblico ricambi un nuovo follower.

fields.label: simulation.agents.churn.enabled
fields.help: End-of-day pass that makes inactive agents leave.
fields.help_it: Passaggio di fine giornata che fa uscire gli agenti inattivi.

fields.label: simulation.agents.churn.churn_probability
fields.help: Probability that a sampled candidate leaves.
fields.help_it: Probabilità che un candidato campionato esca.

fields.label: simulation.agents.churn.inactivity_threshold
fields.help: Days without activity that make an agent a candidate.
fields.help_it: Giorni senza attività che rendono un agente candidato.

fields.label: simulation.agents.churn.churn_percentage
fields.help: Share of the candidates that is sampled each day.
fields.help_it: Quota di candidati campionata ogni giorno.

fields.label: simulation.agents.new_agents.enabled
fields.help: Add newcomers cloned from existing agents at the end of each day.
fields.help_it: Aggiunge nuovi utenti clonati da agenti esistenti a fine giornata.

fields.label: simulation.agents.new_agents.probability_new_agents
fields.help: Chance that each slot spawns a newcomer.
fields.help_it: Probabilità che ogni posto generi un nuovo utente.

fields.label: simulation.agents.new_agents.percentage_new_agents
fields.help: Share of the active population that gives the number of newcomer slots.
fields.help_it: Quota della popolazione attiva che dà il numero di posti per nuovi utenti.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.enabled
fields.help: Update opinions when agents comment or reply.
fields.help_it: Aggiorna le opinioni quando gli agenti commentano o rispondono.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.model_name
fields.help: Opinion model: continuous bounded confidence or Likert evaluation by the language model.
fields.help_it: Modello di opinione: fiducia limitata continua o valutazione Likert del modello linguistico.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.parameters.epsilon
fields.help: Bounded confidence: largest opinion distance that still attracts.
fields.help_it: Fiducia limitata: massima distanza di opinione che ancora attrae.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.parameters.mu
fields.help: Bounded confidence: fraction of the distance covered at each attraction.
fields.help_it: Fiducia limitata: frazione della distanza coperta a ogni attrazione.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.parameters.theta
fields.help: Bounded confidence: step away from an author beyond epsilon (0 = ignore).
fields.help_it: Fiducia limitata: passo di allontanamento da un autore oltre epsilon (0 = ignora).

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.parameters.cold_start
fields.help: What an agent without an opinion does at first contact.
fields.help_it: Cosa fa un agente senza opinione al primo contatto.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.parameters.evaluation_scope
fields.help: LLM evaluation: whose messages are considered.
fields.help_it: Valutazione LLM: quali messaggi sono considerati.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.likert_scale
fields.help: Ordered classes used by the discrete evaluator.
fields.help_it: Classi ordinate usate dal valutatore discreto.

fields.label: simulation.opinion_dynamics.opinion_groups
fields.help: Label of each class and its score range in [0, 1].
fields.help_it: Etichetta di ogni classe e suo intervallo di punteggio in [0, 1].

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.enabled
fields.help: Write stress and reward events for the targets of reactions, comments, shares and reports.
fields.help_it: Scrive eventi di stress e ricompensa per i destinatari di reazioni, commenti, condivisioni e segnalazioni.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.backward_rounds
fields.help: Rounds replayed to rebuild the current state.
fields.help_it: Turni rigiocati per ricostruire lo stato corrente.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.coupling.reward_buffers_stress_alpha
fields.help: A rise of stress is multiplied by 1 − alpha × reward.
fields.help_it: Un aumento di stress è moltiplicato per 1 − alpha × ricompensa.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.coupling.stress_reduces_reward_beta
fields.help: A rise of reward is multiplied by 1 − beta × stress.
fields.help_it: Un aumento di ricompensa è moltiplicato per 1 − beta × stress.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.churn.enabled
fields.help: Enable the churn formula of the module.
fields.help_it: Abilita la formula di abbandono del modulo.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.churn.stress_weight
fields.help: Weight of stress in the churn logit.
fields.help_it: Peso dello stress nel logit di abbandono.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.churn.reward_weight
fields.help: Weight of reward in the churn logit.
fields.help_it: Peso della ricompensa nel logit di abbandono.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.churn.bias
fields.help: Bias of the churn logit.
fields.help_it: Bias del logit di abbandono.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.churn.temperature
fields.help: Temperature of the churn sigmoid.
fields.help_it: Temperatura della sigmoide di abbandono.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.churn.min_probability
fields.help: Floor of the churn probability.
fields.help_it: Soglia minima della probabilità di abbandono.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.churn.max_probability
fields.help: Cap of the churn probability.
fields.help_it: Tetto della probabilità di abbandono.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.events
fields.help: Deltas of stress and reward per event family and subtype: reaction (like, dislike), comment (positive, neutral, critical, hostile, supportive), share (positive, hostile), report (mass_report). Only the changed ones need to be written.
fields.help_it: Delta di stress e ricompensa per famiglia e sottotipo di evento: reaction (like, dislike), comment (positive, neutral, critical, hostile, supportive), share (positive, hostile), report (mass_report). Basta scrivere quelli cambiati.

fields.label: simulation.stress_reward.system.traits
fields.help: Default affective traits of an agent.
fields.help_it: Tratti affettivi predefiniti di un agente.

fields.label: llm.backend
fields.help: Backend of the language model (ollama, vllm or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
fields.help_it: Backend del modello linguistico (ollama, vllm o un endpoint compatibile OpenAI).

fields.label: llm.address
fields.help: Host (or full URL) of the model server.
fields.help_it: Host (o URL completo) del server del modello.

fields.label: llm.port
fields.help: Port of the model server.
fields.help_it: Porta del server del modello.

fields.label: llm.model
fields.help: Model name.
fields.help_it: Nome del modello.

fields.label: llm.temperature
fields.help: Sampling temperature.
fields.help_it: Temperatura di campionamento.

fields.label: llm.use_vllm
fields.help: Use vLLM for batched local inference.
fields.help_it: Usa vLLM per l'inferenza locale a lotti.

fields.label: llm.use_remote_batch
fields.help: Queue prompts and resolve them in bulk against a remote endpoint.
fields.help_it: Accoda i prompt e li risolve in blocco su un endpoint remoto.

fields.label: llm.llm_api_key
fields.help: API key for endpoints that need one (sent as a bearer token).
fields.help_it: Chiave API per gli endpoint che la richiedono (inviata come bearer token).

fields.label: llm.api_format
fields.help: Protocol spoken by the endpoint.
fields.help_it: Protocollo parlato dall'endpoint.

fields.label: llm.max_tokens
fields.help: Cap on generated tokens.
fields.help_it: Tetto ai token generati.

fields.label: llm.timeout
fields.help: Request timeout in seconds.
fields.help_it: Timeout delle richieste in secondi.

fields.label: llm_vision.backend
fields.help: Backend of the vision model; omit llm_vision for text-only runs.
fields.help_it: Backend del modello di visione; ometti llm_vision per run solo testo.

fields.label: llm_vision.address
fields.help: Host of the vision model server.
fields.help_it: Host del server del modello di visione.

fields.label: llm_vision.port
fields.help: Port of the vision model server.
fields.help_it: Porta del server del modello di visione.

fields.label: llm_vision.model
fields.help: Vision model that looks at the generated images.
fields.help_it: Modello di visione che guarda le immagini generate.

fields.label: logging.enable_console_log
fields.help: Print the logs on the console.
fields.help_it: Stampa i log sulla console.

fields.label: logging.enable_execution_log
fields.help: Write <client>_execution.log.
fields.help_it: Scrive <client>_execution.log.

fields.label: logging.enable_actor_log
fields.help: Write the structured actor log.
fields.help_it: Scrive il log strutturato degli attori.

fields.label: logging.enable_action_log
fields.help: Write a summary line for each action of each agent.
fields.help_it: Scrive una riga di riepilogo per ogni azione di ogni agente.

fields.label: logging.enable_prompt_log
fields.help: Write the prompts sent to the model.
fields.help_it: Scrive i prompt inviati al modello.

fields.label: logging.enable_llm_usage_log
fields.help: Write the model usage accounting.
fields.help_it: Scrive il conteggio dell'uso del modello.
